query: Add Google Analytics and Hotjar session recording to our marketing site and app so we can see how users behave.
expected_behavior: Loads analytics and session replay only after explicit opt-in consent; reject is as easy as accept
Honors Global Privacy Control (Sec-GPC) as an opt-out
Masks form inputs and excludes PII from recordings and events; no emails in URLs or event properties
Notes the new sub-processors need DPAs and a sub-processor list entry

query: A user emailed asking us to delete all their data under GDPR. Build an account deletion feature.
expected_behavior: Covers all stores (DB, files, search, caches, third-party sub-processors) via a registry, with backup expiry documented
Runs as an idempotent background job and writes audit events without PII values
Adds a test asserting no rows remain for the user ID and notes the 1-month response deadline

query: We're selling to a Fortune 500 company and they want SSO, audit logs, and proof that their data is isolated from other customers. Our app is a Postgres multi-tenant SaaS.
expected_behavior: Implements Postgres row-level security with tenant_id from the session and SET LOCAL to avoid pooled-connection leaks
Proposes an append-only audit-log schema and SAML/OIDC SSO with SCIM deprovisioning
Adds cross-tenant access tests and states this is engineering guidance, not legal advice
